primary_goal: make component-preset reads reflect mutations made by another catalog instance sharing the same persistence directory
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

registered_hypothesis_check.reason: Independent same-instance, HTTP, and Windows-process checks showed lock-held reload is linearizable for update/delete races and prevents delete-after-update resurrection.

scope.trigger: a long-lived catalog instance reads after another instance or process mutates the same presets.json

data_roles.development: two preconstructed catalogs with create/update/delete interleaving
data_roles.comparison: fresh persisted IDs and detail/page results before and after each mutation
data_roles.holdout: two HTTP servers sharing one directory; independent Windows process contention evidence

guardrails: reload the latest persisted state before page/detail reads
keep atomic write and lock-held mutation behavior unchanged
do not hide corrupt or invalid persisted data as a successful stale read
do not claim native timing or accuracy improvement
run clean .venv full suite before promotion
next_step: review HTTP error mapping for corrupted component-preset persistence
